fields.description: Reject check-ins made outside every enabled office location.
fields.label: Enable Geofence

fields.description: Up to this many metres of reported GPS inaccuracy is added to the radius, so a weak fix inside the building is not rejected.
fields.label: GPS Accuracy Tolerance (m)

fields.description: A location fix less precise than this is refused; the employee is asked to retry outdoors or with GPS on.
fields.label: Max Accepted GPS Accuracy (m)

fields.description: Minimum time between two punches of the same employee.
fields.label: Minimum Gap Between Punches (s)

fields.description: Payroll here is attendance-based. When on, the first check-in of the day creates and submits a Present Attendance record, and each check-out updates its working hours.
fields.label: Create Attendance From Check-ins
Enable Face Verification
fields.description: At an employee's first check-in their face is enrolled; every later punch must match it. Delete the employee's BB HR Face Profile to make them enrol again.

fields.label: Require Head-Turn Liveness Check
fields.description: The employee is asked to turn their head left or right (chosen at random) during the scan, so a printed photo or a still picture on a screen is refused.

fields.label: Face Match Threshold
fields.description: Cosine similarity needed to accept a face (0-1). Higher is stricter. The same person typically scores 0.6-0.9 and different people below 0.3. Do not go below 0.36.
